question: Where should the abode of the seven mothers be made between Sarasvatī and Yama?
premises: the middle of Sarasvatī and Yama is specified
the seven mothers' abode is to be made there
inference: The mātṛ group is placed in the southwestern interval.
uncertainties: whether all seven mothers are enumerated elsewhere
plain_english: Make the abode of the seven mothers in the middle of Sarasvatī and Yama.
